# Microsoft Excel

> Microsoft Excel's cloud-based template library offering free, customizable spreadsheets for financial planning, project management, and business operations with AI-powered Copilot assistance.

Excel Cloud provides a comprehensive collection of multilingual templates designed to help users manage budgets, track projects, organize inventories, and visualize data. The platform integrates Microsoft's Copilot AI to enhance financial planning and decision-making across personal and business use cases.

## Key Topics

- Excel Templates
- Financial Planning
- Project Management
- Budget Management
- Copilot in Excel
- Data Visualization
- Task Management
- Business Budgeting
- Personal Finance
- Inventory Tracking
- Project Planning
- Gantt Charts
- Collaborative Tools
- Spreadsheet Templates
- Timeline Planning

## Template Collections

- [Free Excel Spreadsheet Templates](https://excel.cloud.microsoft/create/fr/templates): Free customizable Excel templates for budgets, projects, and data analysis across multiple languages
- [Free Excel Spreadsheet Templates (Spanish)](https://excel.cloud.microsoft/create/es/templates): Free Excel templates for budgets, projects, accounting, and personal finance in Spanish

## Financial Planning & Budgeting

- [Business Budget Planner (Portuguese)](https://excel.cloud.microsoft/create/pt-br/business-budgeting): Business budget planner with Copilot assistance for financial planning and tracking
- [Business Budget Planner (Russian)](https://excel.cloud.microsoft/create/ru/business-budgeting): Business budget planner with Copilot for financial tracking and analysis
- [Financial Management Templates (French)](https://excel.cloud.microsoft/create/fr/financial-management-templates): Free financial planning templates for accounting and budget management
- [Personal Finance Tracker (Russian)](https://excel.cloud.microsoft/create/ru/personal-finance): Personal finance tracker for budgets and household expense management

## Project & Task Management

- [Project Tracker & Timeline Templates (Dutch)](https://excel.cloud.microsoft/create/nl/project-tracker-timelines): Free project tracking and timeline templates for milestone management
- [Project Tracker & Timeline Templates (Portuguese)](https://excel.cloud.microsoft/create/pt-br/project-tracker-timelines): Free project tracker and timeline templates for milestone and deadline tracking
- [Project Planning & To-Do Lists (Chinese)](https://excel.cloud.microsoft/create/zh-hans/project-planning-to-do-lists): Free project planning and to-do list templates with Gantt chart support
- [Planner & Tracker Templates (Spanish)](https://excel.cloud.microsoft/create/es/planner-tracker-templates): Free project tracking templates for planning and task management

## Specialized Tools & Resources

- [Inventory List Templates (Dutch)](https://excel.cloud.microsoft/create/nl/inventory-templates): Free customizable inventory templates for tracking products and possessions
- [Timesheet Templates (French)](https://excel.cloud.microsoft/create/fr/timesheet-templates): Free timesheet templates for productivity and payroll tracking
- [Chart & Diagram Maker (Italian)](https://excel.cloud.microsoft/create/it/graph-maker): Free chart and diagram creation tool for data visualization in Excel
